Discord.metaDescription: Join Foilio's Discord — the gathering place for Pokémon TCG in Sweden. Real-time restock alerts from Swedish stores, price talk, pulls and trades. Free.
Discord.h1: Pokémon TCG Discord for Swedish collectors
Discord.subtitle: Foilio's Discord server — restocks, prices and pulls, in Swedish.
Discord.intro: We started Foilio's Discord for the same reason we built Foilio: there was no Swedish place to hear that a display had dropped before it was already sold out. The server is free, open to everyone and needs no Foilio account.
Discord.inside1Text: The same monitoring that powers Foilio's alerts is posted in the server — usually within a minute of the store publishing the product. We watch more than 40 Swedish stores.
Discord.inside2Text: What's the card worth, is the display overpriced, does the trend hold? Talk with people who actually follow the Swedish market.
Discord.inside3Text: Show off today's hit, compare pulls and find someone to trade with. Swedish collectors, Swedish shipping.
Discord.inside4Lead: Direct line to the people building it
Discord.inside4Text: Missing a store in the monitoring, or found something wrong in the catalogue? Post it in the server — it's the fastest way to reach us.
Discord.whoBody: Anyone collecting Pokémon cards in Sweden — whether you're chasing sealed for the shelf, building sets number by number, or just want to know when the next Elite Trainer Box lands. Beginners are as welcome as the person who has kept their binders in order since Base Set.
Discord.rulesBody: Swedish or English both work. No spam, no scams, no rudeness. Trades and sales happen between members — Foilio is not a party to the deal and handles no payments.
Discord.alsoBody: Discord is the only place restocks are posted in real time. If you want the alerts as push notifications, the app is on the App Store, and <catalog>the full catalogue with prices and price history</catalog> lives here on the site.

Cookies.metaDescription: Information on how Foilio uses cookies and similar technologies.
Cookies.s1Body: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They are used to make the site work correctly, remember your settings and give us anonymous statistics about how the service is used.
Cookies.necessaryBody: These are required for the service to work, e.g. login sessions and CSRF protection. They can't be turned off.

remembers that you are signed in so menus and buttons render correctly

Cookies.prefBody: Store choices you make yourself. They are only set when you use the feature and therefore require no consent.

Cookies.s3Body: Foilio uses no third-party cookies for tracking or advertising. We never sell data to third parties.
Cookies.s4Body: You can delete or block cookies via your browser settings. Note that the service may stop working correctly if you block necessary cookies (e.g. you can't stay logged in).
Cookies.s5Body: All cookies we use are necessary for the service to function or are set when you use a feature yourself, such as the language choice. The legal basis is therefore legitimate interest or performance of the feature you requested, and no cookie consent is required. Your choice in the cookie banner is stored locally in your browser (localStorage), not as a cookie. Read more in our <link>privacy policy</link>.
Cookies.s6Body: Questions about our cookie handling? Contact us at <email>hej@foilio.se</email>.

Terms.metaDescription: Terms of service for Foilio, the service that helps you track the Pokémon TCG market.
Terms.intro: Foilio is a Swedish web and app service for Pokémon TCG collectors: price data, stock status, market trends, watchlists, collection management, card scanning and AI grading. By creating an account or using the service you accept these terms. Full company details are at the bottom of this page.
Terms.s1Body:
Foilio collects and presents prices, stock status and market trends for Pokémon TCG products from external sources, and offers tools for watching, collection management, card scanning, AI grading and selling through connected accounts.

We are not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by The Pokémon Company, Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK or any retailer or marketplace that appears in the service. We show card images and product names for identification purposes, so you can recognise what you are looking for.

You are responsible for the accuracy of the details you provide and for keeping your login credentials to yourself. Everything that happens through your account counts as done by you. If you believe someone has gained unauthorised access, change your password immediately and contact us.

An account is personal. You may not sell, rent out, lend or transfer it, and you may not create multiple accounts to get around limits or offers in the service.

If you break the rules we may remove content, restrict features or suspend the account. We will contact you first where possible and reasonable, and we choose the mildest measure that solves the problem. What happens to a paid period is covered in section 16.
Terms.s4Body:
Prices, stock status, price history and other market data in Foilio are collected automatically from external sources: Swedish stores' public product pages, two international collectible-card marketplaces (one via a data service, the other via the marketplace's own API) and a Swedish marketplace API. Prices are normally updated once per day, while stock status at the stores we monitor is updated more often, at most every ten minutes. None of it is real-time data.

The data may be delayed, incomplete or incorrect, and it is provided as is without warranties of accuracy, timeliness or availability. The price that applies is always the one shown by the respective store or seller at the time of purchase.

Foilio sells no cards and no products. We are not a party to any purchase, sale or trade that takes place at a store or marketplace you find through the service, and we do not receive payment for such transactions. Questions about an order, a delivery or a complaint should be directed to the seller.

Market data in Foilio is information, not advice. It is not financial advice or a recommendation to buy or sell, and you should not make investment decisions based on it alone. Collectible cards are not a regulated asset and prices can swing sharply.

An external source can change, restrict our access or shut down at any time. If that happens, data or features that depend on that source may disappear or change. We will do what we reasonably can to replace the source, but we cannot promise it will be possible.
Terms.s5Title: 5. Your collection value is an estimate
Terms.s5Body:
The value we show for your collection is an automatic estimate, not an appraisal and not an offer. It is calculated from the lowest price we know of for each product, converted to kronor using a current exchange rate. If no current price exists, the last known one is used, or none at all.

The estimate does not take into account your card's actual condition, its authenticity, whether it is graded, which printing or variant you own, or what someone is actually willing to pay right now. It is not performed by an authorised appraiser and is not suitable as a basis for insurance, estate inventory, credit assessment, disputes or tax returns.

Use it for what it is: a benchmark for following your collection over time.
Terms.s6Body:
How they work. When you scan a card, the image is analysed on your device and compared against our catalog. If needed, a cropped image is sent to our AI provider to read the card's collector number. When you grade a card, your photos of the front and back are sent to an AI model that assesses centering, corners, edges and surface.

Both produce estimates, not facts.

The scanner can identify the wrong card. It is especially uncertain when the collector number is not visible in the image, which is common when photographing a screen, in poor lighting, or when the card is in a sleeve. Some cards also exist in several printings with identical artwork but very different value, and they can only be told apart by the collector number. Always check that the card the scanner suggests really is yours before adding it to your collection, especially the printing and variant.

The grading is an indicative assessment of your photos. It is not an official grade from PSA, BGS, CGC or any other grading company, and we do not promise that a grading company would reach the same result. An AI cannot feel the card, hold it against the light or detect a counterfeit. Use the grade as a benchmark, never as a verdict.

We may replace, update or adjust the models used. The result for the same card can therefore differ over time.

Your responsibility. You are responsible for decisions you make with the help of the scanner or the grading, for example buying, selling, pricing, insuring or submitting a card for real grading. We are not liable for such decisions or their consequences. Only upload images you have taken yourself or have the right to use.

Your images. Images you scan or upload are processed to identify or assess the card and are not stored by our AI provider after processing. We do not use your images to train AI models. Read more in our privacy policy.

Quotas. How many scans and gradings are included per month is shown on the pricing page. See section 11 on fair use.
Terms.s7Body:
Foilio can send price and restock alerts via email and push notifications. Alerts are sent on a best-effort basis. We cannot promise that an alert is sent, that it arrives, that it arrives in time, or that the product is still available when you click.

There are several reasons for this. We detect a stock change only when the store's data updates with us, and a product can sell out before that. We also deliberately dampen alerts: a product that blinks in and out of stock within minutes does not alert every time, and a product that flips many times per day gets one combined notice instead of one per hour. This is so the alerts can be trusted rather than drowning in noise.

Email can end up in spam or be blocked by your provider. Push notifications require that you have given the app permission on your device and that the device has a network connection. You control which alerts you receive in Settings and can turn them off whenever you want.

Alerts are a help to keep track, not a guarantee that you get there first.
Terms.s8Body:
Foilio links to external stores and marketplaces. We do not operate them and do not control their content, prices, stock, terms or processing of personal data. When you click through, their terms apply, not ours.

How we rank. The default sorting Best match combines how well a product matches your search with a quality assessment of the product: how much it engages other users, how many are watching it, whether it can be bought right now, how many stores sell it, whether it has an image and a price, and how recently the set was released. If you are signed in, products you already watch or own, and products in sets you have picked as favorites, can get a small boost. The formula is set by us by hand and you can always change the sort order yourself.

We currently receive no compensation from stores or marketplaces when you click through via us, and no one can pay to influence the ranking. Should we introduce sponsored placements in the future, they will be clearly marked as sponsored, kept separate from the organic ranking and never affect it. If any of this changes we will update these terms and inform you in the service.

You are responsible for the content. That includes price, condition, authenticity, images, shipping, delivery and that you actually own what you sell. Tradera's terms apply between you and Tradera, including their fees, rules for what may be sold and dispute handling. We cannot promise that a listing is published, stays up, ends up in the right category or looks the way you intended. Tradera can end the connection or remove a listing under its own rules.

Tax is your responsibility. If you sell regularly or at a profit it can affect your tax return. Marketplaces are in some cases required to report sellers to the Swedish Tax Agency. We do not give tax advice.

Renewal. Pro runs monthly with no lock-in and renews automatically until you cancel. The fee is charged at the start of each new period. If you cancel, Pro remains active until the end of the period you have already paid for, and you are not charged again.

Privacy.s3Outro: We never sell your data and don't use it for third-party marketing.
Privacy.s4Body: We keep your data for as long as you have an account. If you delete the account, your personal data is removed within 30 days, except for data we are legally required to keep (e.g. bookkeeping records, kept for 7 years). Backups are cleared continuously and at the latest within 90 days. Technical operations history (scan diagnostics, sent alerts and internal logs) is kept for at most 12 months, and anonymous usage statistics for at most 90 days.
Privacy.s5Intro: Under GDPR you have the right to:

s5Items.text: the data we hold about you,
your data in a machine-readable format (data portability),
object to or request restriction of certain processing,
lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).

Privacy.s5Outro: Export and deletion are available directly in Settings in the service. You don't need to contact us to exercise your rights, but you're always welcome to.
Privacy.s6Body: We only use necessary and functional cookies: sign-in cookies, a cookie that remembers that you are signed in so menus render correctly, and a cookie that stores your language choice when you switch language yourself. We use no third-party tracking or marketing cookies. Since all cookies are necessary for features you request yourself, no consent is required, but we inform you about them via our cookie banner. Your choice in the banner is stored locally in your browser, not as a cookie. Read more in our <link>cookie policy</link>.
Privacy.s7Intro: We use the following processors to run the service, all bound by data processing agreements:

s7Items.text: Neon (serverless PostgreSQL, data stored within the EU/EEA, Frankfurt).
Railway, which runs the application (EU region).
Resend, for alerts and account emails (USA).

s7Items.lead: AI identification and grading of cards:
s7Items.text: Google (Gemini) and Anthropic (Claude), which process scanned card images (USA). Images are not stored by the provider after processing and are not used to train models.
Stripe, which handles the payment and your card details (Ireland/USA). We never see your card number.
RevenueCat, which keeps track of purchases made via App Store and Google Play (USA).
Sentry, which receives technical error reports so we can find and fix bugs. Reports may contain technical details about your request.

Privacy.s7Outro: Storage of your account data takes place within the EU/EEA. For transfers to third countries (e.g. the USA for email, AI identification and error diagnostics), approved safeguards under GDPR are used, such as the EU's standard contractual clauses. We never sell your data.
Privacy.s8Body: For material changes to this policy, we'll inform you by email or in the service. The latest version is always on this page. See also our <link>terms of use</link>.
Privacy.s7bTitle: 7b. Recipients responsible in their own right
Privacy.s7bIntro: Some services receive data from us but process it as independent data controllers, under their own privacy policies. We do not have processor agreements with them, since they do not process the data on our behalf:

s7bItems.text: are the seller when you buy Pro in the app and then handle the payment under their own terms.

if you choose to link your Discord account, we share your Discord ID and your membership level (e.g. Pro) to add you to our server and assign the right role. We share no email address and nothing else about your activity.
if you choose to sell through your Tradera connection, we share the data required to create the listing you requested.
if you enable push on an iPhone, the notification is delivered via Apple's push service (APNs), which then receives your device's push token and the notification's content in order to deliver it.

Privacy.s7bOutro: The connections are always optional and can be removed in Settings.

About.metaDescription: Foilio is Sweden's marketplace platform for Pokémon TCG: price tracking, restock alerts and collection tools.
About.subtitle: Sweden's Pokémon TCG platform
About.whatBody: Foilio is a Swedish web platform built for Pokémon TCG collectors. We gather prices and stock status from Swedish stores so you do not have to check every site manually. Here you can compare prices, watch products, get restock alerts, scan your cards, get an AI assessment of their condition and keep track of your collection's value, all in one place.
About.do1Text: We fetch prices from several Swedish stores and show the lowest price, price history and trends.
About.do2Text: Get notifications the moment a product you watch is back in stock.
About.do3Text: Log your cards and sealed products, see total value and follow how your collection develops.
About.do4Text: Trends, price drops, most-watched products and a set index keep you on top of the market.
About.do5Text: scan your cards with the camera to add them to your collection, and get an indicative AI assessment of their condition. Both are estimates, not official verdicts.
About.independentBody: Foilio is a completely independent service. We are not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by The Pokémon Company, Nintendo or any retailer. Pokémon and related names are trademarks of their respective owners.
About.contactBody: Have questions, feedback or want to report a problem? Write to <email>hej@foilio.se</email> or visit our <link>contact page</link>.
About.rankingBody:
The default sorting Best match combines how well a product matches your search with a quality assessment: engagement from other users, how many are watching the product, whether it can be bought right now, how many stores sell it, whether it has an image and a price, and how recently the set was released. If you are signed in, products you already watch or own, and products in sets you have picked as favorites, can get a small boost. The formula is set by us by hand, and you can always change the sort order yourself.

No one can pay to influence the ranking. We currently receive no compensation from stores when you click through. Should we introduce sponsored placements in the future, they will be clearly marked and kept separate from the organic ranking.

faqItems.q: Can I switch plans any time?
faqItems.a: Yes. The subscription renews monthly and you can cancel whenever you like, with no lock-in — you keep Pro until the end of the period. If you buy on the web, payment is handled by Stripe and you cancel under Manage subscription on the pricing page. If you buy in the app, everything is handled by the App Store or Google Play, and you cancel there.

faqItems.q: What happens to my watches if I downgrade?
faqItems.a: Your watches are kept — nothing is deleted. On the free tier you can't add new ones until you're down to 5, and alerts are paused until you upgrade again.

faqItems.q: How do I pay for Pro?
faqItems.a: In the app the purchase is made securely via the App Store or Google Play. On the web, payment is handled securely by Stripe — we never see your card number. You can cancel any time and keep Pro until the end of the period.
